app-templates.message:
fix(explainer): the short tutor prompt names every address the tutor may fetch

## Intent

A chat assistant fetches only addresses its user wrote into the conversation, not those it finds in a fetched file. The short prompt named only the tutor file, so the fetch of llms.txt and of the pages' tutor files was refused.

## Key changes

- The short prompt lists llms.txt and the tutor file of every page, and says that these addresses may be fetched when needed.
- The full prompt says that every address in it may be fetched.
- When the list would make the short prompt too long for an assistant's address, only the list falls away.

## Dependencies and side effects

- The tooling pins this version in the same intent.
